camel_example: aliyun ons OnsInstanceInServiceList --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key CartService --Tag.1.Value SericeA --NeedResourceInfo true
description_en: Queries all ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ 4.x instances in a specified region
description_zh: 查询当前账号在指定地域（Region）下所有的云消息队列 RocketMQ 版4.x实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-instance-in-service-list --tag Value=SericeA Key=CartService --need-resource-info true --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsInstanceInServiceList

fields.help_en:
The tag key. Specify both Key and Value to filter instances by tag. Omit both to query all instances.

This parameter cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters long. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的实例，若不输入表示查询所有实例。

如果输入该值，则取值不允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Specify both Key and Value to filter instances by tag. Omit both to query all instances.

This parameter can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters long. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的实例，若不输入表示查询所有实例。

如果输入该值，取值允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: A list of tags attached to the instance. The list can contain up to 20 elements
parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签列表。列表元素个数不得超过 20
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return resource statistics. The statistics include the number of topics and groups in the instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要资源统计信息。即实例下Topic的数量和Group的数量
parameters.name: need_resource_info

InstanceVO.description_en: A list of all published instances
InstanceVO.description_zh: 返回所有已发布的实例信息列表

items.description_en: A list of all published instances
items.description_zh: 返回所有已发布的实例信息列表

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the instance was created.
This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例的创建时间。
该参数值的格式为毫秒级Unix时间戳

IndependentNaming.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has a namespace. Valid values:

true: The instance has an independent namespace. Resource names must be unique within the instance, but can be the same as resource names in other instances.

false: The instance does not have an independent namespace. Resource names must be globally unique within the instance and across all instances
IndependentNaming.description_zh:
实例是否有命名空间。取值说明如下：

true：拥有独立命名空间，资源命名确保实例内唯一，跨实例之间可重名。

false：无独立命名空间，实例内或者跨实例之间，资源命名必须全局唯一

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

0: The Platinum instance is being deployed.

2: The payment for the standard instance is overdue.

5: The standard or Platinum instance is in service.

7: The Platinum instance is being upgraded and is available
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态。取值说明如下：

0：铂金版实例部署中

2：标准版实例已欠费

5：标准版实例或铂金版实例服务中

7：铂金版实例升级中且服务可用

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the instance. Valid values:

1: Standard instance

2: Platinum instance

For information about the specifications and differences between instance types, see [Instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185261.html）
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。取值说明如下：

1：标准版实例

2：铂金版实例

各类型实例的规格和差异说明，请参见[实例规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185261.html）

ReleaseTime.description_en: The expiration time of the Platinum instance
ReleaseTime.description_zh: 铂金版实例的过期时间

Tag.description_en: The tags attached to the instance

items.description_en: The tags attached to the instance

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
